note: Site content version the kit's components were last reviewed against. `npm run md3 -- check` reports drift; re-audit and bump when it moves (conventions.md, "Spec review"). `carbonVersion` is the last version the *whole* list was covered against: each component either read in full that day, which is the date beside it, or shown unchanged by the site's own dates — its page `updated` date and its token table's revision both strictly earlier than the date beside it — in which case it keeps that date. A date is bumped only for what was really read. The components Material 3 does not describe are deliberately absent: an audit entry pointing at a page that does not exist is a false citation. They are the group named in README.md, "What this kit is", and each says so in its doc comment instead.
